field_checks.summary: All current final activity records were enumerated against the XML/PDF/supplement surfaces. The layer is not publication-grade because multiple accepted rows have source-conflicted target or assay-material fields: Table 2 rows 1-16 are assigned to Clostridium perfringens EM124 although the source states Lactococcus lactis HP was the indicator; Fig. 6 fraction-51 WDA is assigned to C. perfringens although the source states L. innocua DPC 3572 was used; non-Clostridium Table 1 rows are represented as CFSN despite the source spot-on-lawn producer-cell method.

Layer 1 was reviewed over all 5 final database audits. The source peptide identity, mature 61-residue sequence, 63-residue precursor, and head-to-tail cyclization boundary are internally consistent, and every plain sequence/sequence_length pair counted exactly. However, local authoritative DBAASP/merged linked rows are absent; all 5 rows remain fallback machine candidates with authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false, so this is acceptable only as a preserved database caution, not authoritative ingest.

All shared paper-final and packet-final JSON files are byte-identical. The packet-only mechanism_evidence.json is a byte-identical alias of mechanism_ontology_record.json. Final counts are activity_records=45, toxicity_records=0, database_record_audits=5, mechanism_claims=3. Review-report open_rework_ticket_count=0 matches the live packet ticket state computed from the latest closed_repaired response for all 10 request IDs.

All 3 final mechanism claims were reviewed. The final mechanism layer keeps direct_mechanism count at 0, separates phenotype-supported activity from inferred gene-cluster context, and explicitly records direct mechanism as unknown/not tested. No primary XML/PDF/supplement surface supported SPR, ribosome-binding, permeability, imaging, or other direct mechanism promotion for leucocyclicin C.

Paper identity matches DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-89450-x, PMID 39984510, PMCID PMC11845615, and the Scientific Reports title. The audited entity is leucocyclicin C from Leuconostoc lactis APC 3969; the final mature sequence length count is 61 and the precursor count is 63, with cyclization represented as a non-residue terminal modification.

Sequence-length normalization checks passed, and terminal cyclization was not counted as a residue. The activity provenance is nevertheless not clean: the accepted MIC record retains ticket-required unresolved scaffold locators xml:p:17 and xml:p:36 inside source_locator despite noting they do not support the MIC value/method, and the Table 2/Fig. 6 rows cite locators whose source target fields contradict the final target fields.

Fallback/database candidate rows remain excluded from authoritative ingest and release boundaries: authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false, linked authoritative row counts are zero, and fallback rows are not promoted to RC2/portal/authoritative status. Non-source work paths appear as audit provenance rather than primary-source support for accepted mechanism/database claims.

The final review preserves database and mechanism cautions, but it does not preserve the newly verified source conflict in Layer 2 activity targets and assay material. The final accepted_with_cautions status reports zero rework targets even though Table 2, Supplementary Fig. S1, Fig. 6, and non-Clostridium Table 1 assay-material fields require worker-2 repair.

The single staged DOCX supplement was readable and its two embedded images were inspected. No supplementary tables are present. Supplementary Fig. S1 is activity-related sensitivity evidence, but the final excluded_source_surfaces object assigns the target to Clostridium perfringens EM124 rather than the source-supported Lactococcus lactis HP sensitivity-assay context, so the supplement is not correctly represented.

No hemolysis, cytotoxicity, viability, HC50/CC50, or selectivity assay rows were source-located in the inspected XML/PDF/supplement surfaces. The final toxicity_records array is empty with a no_source_located_toxicity_rows status, which matches the source review.

blocking_findings.reason: Layer-2 final activity_toxicity_evidence.json is scientifically not source-reviewable at field level. In final activity_records[27..42], all 16 Table 2 treatment/stability R/S observations set target_species and indicator_target_species to Clostridium perfringens EM124, but the source states these sensitivity/stability assays used Lactococcus lactis HP as the indicator. In final activity_records[43], the Fig. 6 fraction-51 WDA activity surface is also assigned to C. perfringens EM124, but the source states WDA with L. innocua DPC 3572 was used to follow purification. Final activity_records[0..25] also set assayed_entity/treatment to CFSN from Leuconostoc lactis APC 3969 for all Table 1 rows, while the methods distinguish spot-on-lawn producer-cell assays for non-Clostridium indicators from WDA/CFSN only for the Clostridium rows. The accepted MIC row further retains unsupported unresolved scaffold locators xml:p:17 and xml:p:36 inside source_locator. These are material target/strain/assay-condition/provenance errors, not infrastructure failures.
required_actions: Rebuild the worker-2 activity layer so Table 2 and Supplementary Fig. S1 use the source-supported Lactococcus lactis HP indicator context, not Clostridium perfringens EM124.

Rebuild the Fig. 6 fraction-51 WDA activity row with L. innocua DPC 3572 as the indicator target, or demote it to a target-qualified purification activity surface if it is not a comparable antimicrobial endpoint.

Correct Table 1 assay material/protocol fields so non-Clostridium indicator rows are represented as spot-on-lawn producer-cell activity and only the starred Clostridium rows use WDA with neutralized CFSN.

Remove unsupported ticket-required scaffold locators from accepted MIC source_locator fields, or move them to non-authoritative audit provenance outside source_locator with explicit non-support status.
After repair, re-run source-level row enumeration and worker-6 adjudication so final review_report has non-empty rework_targets until these field repairs pass.
acceptance_checks: Enumerate final activity_records and assert all 16 Table 2 rows have target_species Lactococcus lactis, target_strain_or_isolate HP, and method/source locators to xml:p:9, xml:p:45, or xml:p:46 plus xml:table-wrap:2.
Assert the Fig. 6 activity row has target_species Listeria innocua and target_strain_or_isolate DPC 3572, or is explicitly excluded/demoted with that source context preserved.
Assert Table 1 non-Clostridium rows do not use CFSN as the assayed material, while rows for Clostridium perfringens EM124 and Clostridium tyrobutyricum DSM 663 preserve the WDA/CFSN exception.
Assert accepted MIC source_locator entries contain only source locators that actually support the MIC result or method fields, with no unresolved scaffold locators embedded in source_locator.
Run the strict semantic/publication gates and an independent source cross-check over Table 1, Table 2, Fig. 6, Fig. 7, and Supplementary Fig. S1 with zero worker-2 field mismatches.

cautions.summary: Authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP linked rows are absent in the packet. The five DBAASP rows are fallback machine candidates only and remain excluded from authoritative ingest.
The source supports antimicrobial phenotype and inferred gene-cluster/cyclization context, but no direct antibacterial mechanism assay is source-located.
No toxicity or selectivity assay rows were found in the inspected source surfaces; downstream therapeutic-window claims should remain unsupported.
